supersedes: RC04_REQUIRED_MUTATIONS_v3 (preserved on disk unchanged; v4 = the same fifteen entries verbatim plus the seven RC-0.4E laws -- nothing replaced or deleted)
law: The receipt status law must find EXACTLY this mutation set in the fresh mutation report: same names, same count, same file/test pairs, every one applied and caught by a semantic AssertionError. A missing, extra, renamed, or re-targeted mutation REFUTES the status. This file's canonical-content digest is pinned in generate_rc02_receipt.py; editing either without the other is detected as tampering.

mutations.name: publication_without_diagnostic_commit
mutations.target_law: PUB_LAW_NO_DIAGNOSTIC_COMMIT

mutations.name: diagnostic_eligibility_bypassed
mutations.target_law: LAW_DCR_REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_RECORD

mutations.name: publication_base_state_check_removed
mutations.target_law: PUB_LAW_STALE_STATE

mutations.name: any_examiner_receipt_accepted
mutations.target_law: LAW_RECEIPT_NOT_ISSUED

mutations.name: op_kind_verification_removed
mutations.target_law: verifier envelope: wrong op_kind -> off_axis

mutations.name: stale_effect_tick_accepted
mutations.target_law: verifier envelope: stale originating_tick -> off_axis

mutations.name: consumed_receipts_omitted_from_seal
mutations.target_law: seal binds the consumed-receipt registries

mutations.name: split_sibling_cancellation_removed
mutations.target_law: split failure cancels unsettled siblings; no orphan publication

mutations.name: cjtstep_snapshot_validation_removed
mutations.target_law: STEP_METADATA_REJECTED: no snapshot laundering, no false Effect provenance

mutations.name: verifier_finalization_gate_removed
mutations.target_law: verifier.verify refuses after finalization (issuance registry is seal-bound state)

mutations.name: verifier_configuration_preflight_removed
mutations.target_law: every ACCEPTED verifier configuration is preflight-validated and sealable before the first tick

mutations.name: constructor_schema_bypassed
mutations.target_law: ONE schema governs every constructor parameter; a sealable-but-illegal value is rejected at construction

mutations.name: final_publication_barrier_removed
mutations.target_law: publication is PROVISIONAL until the final-seal barrier; an unsealed run holds zero publications

mutations.name: asom_zero_score_action_dispatch_removed
mutations.target_law: cutoff dispatches repair and breakdown dispatches quarantine; ASOM actions are load-bearing

mutations.name: snapshot_whole_object_detach_removed
mutations.target_law: runtime_snapshot returns one fully detached object; no member aliases live state

mutations.name: scheduler_tick_capability_removed
mutations.target_law: run() owns execution: the lifecycle phase guard on every execution internal (plus the tick scheduler token as defense-in-depth)

mutations.name: publication_finalization_permit_removed
mutations.target_law: promotion requires a one-use FinalizationPermit bound to the exact provisional sets

mutations.name: result_finalization_requirement_removed
mutations.target_law: result() exists only in a terminal phase (FINALIZED or FAULTED)

mutations.name: finalization_fault_boundary_removed
mutations.target_law: the whole finalization is one guarded transaction; any exception yields a typed, voided, FAULTED terminal state

mutations.name: split_active_branch_check_removed
mutations.target_law: SPLIT obeys every branch ceiling; the branch-count unit is the child branch

mutations.name: global_cause_id_check_removed
mutations.target_law: cause ids are globally unique; generated child ids are reserved with deterministic collision handling

mutations.name: cutoff_self_clear_guard_removed
mutations.target_law: a ready-but-cutoff route cannot clear itself by relabeling; typed CUTOFF_CAUSE_UNRESOLVED, non-conducting
